notes: Coordinates in mm; rotations are KiCad degrees; final element is side. These are recommendations from a read-only board audit; root owns final layout.
C105 bypasses VDDA55/56. C104 bypasses CPU46. C103 bypasses RTC20. C106 provides supplemental VDDA1uF. C107 is bulk decoupling and can move if needed.
C10518.4/5.3, C10217.4/9.1 and L10015.7/8.7 avoid native footprint courtyard overlaps. Horizontal L10120.4/5.0 fits between the crystal and MCU courtyards.
Do not lock pullups, straps or SPI series resistors at their current positions before critical decouplers and the crystal are locked. R100 and C111 may need moving from their earlier positions.

The 200 assigned core/USB/data/button pins in exported hierarchical KiCad XML match parts.json. AHCT125 supply, common OE drive, USBLC6 pinmap, native USB pins and BAT54C button polarity were independently checked.

Route each small bypass directly to its designated power pin and a very short ground via. Keep the VDD_SPI power route short and flash SPI routes below30mm, preferably much shorter and ground-referenced.
U5/Q3 relocation from under the crystal to the lower board region is recommended. Keep grounded copper under the clock and RF feed, except the antenna6x6mm keepout.
This artifact is not a final placement or routing signoff. Later parent placement overrides take precedence.
